description: Manage Node.js packages with the pnpm package manager.

parameters.name: dev
parameters.description: Install dependencies in development mode. Pnpm ignores any regular dependencies in package.json. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: executable
parameters.description: The executable location for pnpm. The default location it searches for is PATH, fails if not set.

parameters.name: global
parameters.description: Install the Node.js library globally. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: ignore_scripts
parameters.description: Use the --ignore-scripts flag when installing. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of a Node.js library to install. All packages in package.json are installed if not provided.

parameters.name: no_optional
parameters.description: Do not install optional packages, equivalent to --no-optional. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: optional
parameters.description: Install dependencies in optional mode. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The base path to install the Node.js libraries.

parameters.name: production
parameters.description: Install dependencies in production mode. Pnpm ignores any dependencies under devDependencies in package.json. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Installation state of the named Node.js library. If absent is selected, a name option must be provided. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent" "latest"

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: The version of the library to be installed, in semver format.

examples:
- name: Install "tailwindcss" Node.js package.
  community.general.pnpm:
    name: tailwindcss
    path: /app/location

- name: Install "tailwindcss" Node.js package on version 3.3.2
  community.general.pnpm:
    name: tailwindcss
    version: 3.3.2
    path: /app/location

- name: Install "tailwindcss" Node.js package globally.
  community.general.pnpm:
    name: tailwindcss
    global: true

- name: Install "tailwindcss" Node.js package as dev dependency.
  community.general.pnpm:
    name: tailwindcss
    path: /app/location
    dev: true

- name: Install "tailwindcss" Node.js package as optional dependency.
  community.general.pnpm:
    name: tailwindcss
    path: /app/location
    optional: true

- name: Install "tailwindcss" Node.js package version 0.1.3 as tailwind-1
  community.general.pnpm:
    name: tailwindcss
    alias: tailwind-1
    version: 0.1.3
    path: /app/location

- name: Remove the globally-installed package "tailwindcss".
  community.general.pnpm:
    name: tailwindcss
    global: true
    state: absent

- name: Install packages based on package.json.
  community.general.pnpm:
    path: /app/location

- name: Update all packages in package.json to their latest version.
  community.general.pnpm:
    path: /app/location
    state: latest
